verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਵਡੇ ਦੀ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ।
verses.translit_en: kevadd vaddaa aakheeaai vadde dhee vaddee vaddiaaiee|

en.bdb: How vast could He be said? The grandeur of the Great is great.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਹੂ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖ ਸੁਣਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: vaddee hoo vaddaa aakheeaai sun sun aakhan aakh sunaiee|

en.bdb: I relate what I have heard that He is said to be the greatest of the great.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਭੰਡ ਕਰੋੜ ਸਮਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: rom rom vich rakhion kar varabha(n)dd karoR samaiee|

en.bdb: Crores of universes reside in His trichome.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਕਵਾਉ ਪਸਾਉ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੋਲਿ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਨ ਤੁਲਿ ਤੁਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: eik kavaau pasaau jis tol atol na tul tulaiee|

en.bdb: None could be compared with Him Who created and spread everything with one bang.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਕਥੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: vedh katebahu baaharaa akath kahaanee kathee na jaiee|

en.bdb: He is beyond all the statements of the Vedas and the Katebas. His ineffable story is beyond all descriptions.
How could His unmanifest dynamism by seen and understood?
